welcome.title: Welcome to warpdrv
welcome.body: Let's get you set up in a few quick steps — configure your model folders, learn the basics, and start running models.

modelFolders.overview: Your models are stored in the following folders:

backends.noReleases: No releases available for this OS.

hub.title: Download Models from the Hub
hub.description: Browse the Hub page to search for GGUF models from HuggingFace. Filter by parameters, sort by downloads, and download directly to your model folders.

backends.title: Add a Backend
backends.description: Register your llama.cpp builds on the Backends page. WarpCore validates the binary and detects available GPU devices for each backend.

launch.title: Launch a Server
launch.description: Click the launch button on the Servers page. Pick a backend, select a model, configure GPU layers and context size, then start your inference server.

done.title: All Set
done.body: You're ready to start running local LLMs. Add models, register backends, and launch your first server whenever you're ready. You can always re-run this guide from Settings.
